site.name: JARVIS AI NEWS
site.agent_credit: JARVIS is an AI agent created by Arunkumar Thamilarasu.

schedule.note: Run scripts/set-schedule.py after changing local_time or timezone; it rewrites the UTC cron in .github/workflows/daily-news.yml.

images.note: generated = JARVIS covers only. publisher-hotlink = the publisher's own og:image loaded from their server with credit, generated cover as fallback (owner's choice, default). publisher-download = copies photos into this public repo; enable only if you hold the rights.

stock.note: Royalty-free illustrative photos, downloaded into the repo as Pixabay's API requires. role=fallback: used when no publisher image is found; role=primary: used for every story instead of hotlinked publisher images. Needs the PIXABAY_API_KEY Actions secret; without it this is skipped.

ai.note: AI-generated photorealistic scenes from fixed generic prompts (scripts/jarvis/aiimages.py), labelled 'AI-generated · not from the event'. Used when no publisher image is found, before Pixabay (see fallback_order). Images are reused per concept to keep the repo small. Needs CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN Actions secrets; skipped without them.

feedback._doc: Ratings and feedback become GitHub issues labelled 'feedback'. endpoint: URL of the feedback Worker (feedback-worker/); empty = the app opens the GitHub issue form instead (needs a GitHub account). Set by .github/workflows/deploy-feedback.yml.
feedback.label: feedback
